summary.text: Tom Wieck is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Kerry Gruenhagen.
Wieck is retired and describes a 25-year career in operational excellence across aerospace, defense, healthcare and agribusiness.

paragraphs.text: Wieck earned a high school diploma from Valley High School, a bachelor's degree from Colby College in 1989 and a graduate degree from the University of Iowa in 2008.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in West Des Moines, the son and grandson of homebuilders, and that he worked as a teenager hauling newspapers and later taught English in Tokyo for two years.
He said he has spent the past 25 years in a career focused on operational excellence, leading improvements across aerospace, defense, healthcare and agribusiness.
Wieck advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
In the survey he listed three campaign messages: accountability, lowering costs, and supporting farmers and rural communities.
On costs, he said he would work for working families and fair wages, including raising Iowa's minimum wage, and for supporting local businesses.
